crossRefs.note: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

parallels.note: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

people.name: Etham
people.line: Wilderness area where Israelites camped during the Exodus

people.name: Succoth
people.line: First Israelite campsite after leaving Egypt during Exodus

translations.web: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
translations.bsb: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
translations.kjv: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
